decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and removal spells to quickly deplete the opponent's life total. Utilizing cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Fatal Push to control the board while creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Graveyard Trespasser chip away at the opponent's life. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Dreadbore to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of powerful creatures and removal spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through sheer aggression and efficiency.

The deck focuses on sacrificing creatures for value, utilizing cards like Witch's Oven and Mayhem Devil to trigger effects from sacrificing creatures. It also includes cards that allow you to steal your opponent's creatures temporarily, maximizing the benefits of sacrificing them. The companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, provides additional mana ramp and flexibility in deckbuilding. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and efficient use of sacrifice mechanics to gain an advantage in the game.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on building a board presence quickly with low-cost creatures like Dreadhorde Arcanist, Favored Hoplite, and Monastery Swiftspear. The deck utilizes powerful combat tricks such as Ancestral Anger, Homestead Courage, and Gods Willing to protect and enhance its creatures, while also incorporating removal spells like Reckless Rage. The addition of the Jegantha companion provides additional mana acceleration and flexibility. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures and efficient spells to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with creatures like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves to power out big green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. The deck also utilizes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner to generate even more mana and card advantage. The deck's key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a high amount of green devotion, allowing for powerful plays like casting multiple spells in a turn or generating massive amounts of mana with Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.

This deck focuses on using a combination of cheap, evasive spirits and powerful anthem effects to quickly overwhelm the opponent. With the ability to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal, while building a wide board presence to close out the game quickly, it aims to out-tempo the opponent and maintain pressure throughout the game. By carefully curating a mix of versatile creatures and disruptive spells, the deck seeks to punish slower or greedier strategies while presenting a robust and consistent threat in the combat phase.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly applying pressure on the opponent with a mix of aggressive creatures and removal spells. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, while also presenting threats that can close out the game quickly such as Bloodtithe Harvester and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. The deck aims to control the board early and then finish off the opponent with its powerful creatures and direct damage spells.

This aggro red deck focuses on fast and efficient damage dealing to overwhelm opponents quickly. It employs cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel, Monastery Swiftspear, and Soul-Scar Mage to deal damage while maintaining a low mana curve. Additional burn spells like Lightning Strike and Play with Fire help to control the board and finish off opponents. The inclusion of cards like Chandra, Dressed to Kill and Torbran, Thane of Red Fell add additional pressure and damage potential. The deck aims to win through consistent aggression and efficient use of resources.

The main concept of this Arclight Phoenix aggro deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with instant and sorcery spells, enabling the recurring of Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. The deck includes card draw and filtering spells to fuel this strategy, along with disruptive spells like Spell Pierce to prevent the opponent from stopping the Phoenix from returning. The deck also features efficient removal spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to control the board while applying pressure with the flying Arclight Phoenix. The mana base is optimized to support the aggressive game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix and other powerful cards. It utilizes card draw and selection to find the necessary pieces to enable the Phoenix to return from the graveyard multiple times. Ledger Shredder helps mill cards while also providing utility as a creature. Galvanic Iteration can create copies of powerful spells like Treasure Cruise or Lightning Axe. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive gameplay style while utilizing synergies with Phoenix and other cards to maintain momentum.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly build a board presence of powerful spirit creatures and use tempo plays to disrupt the opponent's strategies while maintaining pressure through aggressive attacks. By combining flying threats like Ascendant Spirit and Shacklegeist with disruptive elements like Mausoleum Wanderer and Rattlechains, this deck aims to control the game's pace and take advantage of favorable combat situations. Cards like Curious Obsession and Spell Pierce help to maintain card advantage and protect your creatures, while Faceless Haven can serve as a late-game finisher when necessary.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize spirits with flying abilities to create a fast-paced aggressive strategy, known as aggro-tempo. By curving out with low-cost creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Spectral Sailor, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with flying creatures while disrupting their game plan with cards like Spell Queller and Shacklegeist. The inclusion of cards like Collected Company and Supreme Phantom further enhance the deck's synergy and overall power level. The focus on tempo and aggression sets this Azorius Spirit Aggro deck apart from other strategies in the format.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. It includes powerful planeswalkers like Chandra, Torch of Defiance and efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore. The creatures in the deck can quickly apply pressure to the opponent, with cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Graveyard Trespasser. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy, with a mix of dual lands and utility lands to ensure consistency in casting spells. The deck also includes graveyard recursion and versatile spells like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker for added flexibility in gameplay.

The main concept of this Weenie White aggro deck is to flood the board with low-cost creatures and pump them up using cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Luminarch Aspirant. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a large number of small but powerful creatures, backed up by protection options like Brave the Elements and Giant Killer. The deck also includes cards like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben to provide additional value and disruption to the opponent's game plan. The aggressive strategy is aided by lands like Castle Ardenvale and Shefet Dunes to help push through the final points of damage.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy centered around Human creatures. By using cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Thalia's Lieutenant to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also boosting the power of your own creatures, combined with cards like Collected Company to quickly put more threats on the board, this deck aims to outpace and outvalue the opponent to secure victory in the Pioneer format. The mana base is set up to support the aggressive strategy while also providing some utility in the form of dual lands.

This Rakdos Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. By utilizing powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Graveyard Trespasser, backed up by removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore, the deck looks to control the board and push damage through quickly. Cards like Tenacious Underdog and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger provide additional pressure and disruption. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to go all-in on aggression and close out the game quickly.
